name: TeraWulf Justified Data campus (Hawesville)
summary: TeraWulf is redeveloping the former Century Aluminum facility at Hawesville, Kentucky, acquired in early 2026, into an AI data center campus with more than 250 buildable acres, an energized on-site substation and about 480 MW of available power. In July 2026 Anthropic signed a 20-year lease for about 401 MW of critical IT load, expected to bring about $19 billion of rent over the initial term. Kentucky regulators approved a retail electric service agreement of up to 482 MW in August 2026. TeraWulf targets initial capacity in the second half of 2027 and the full 401 MW by early 2028.
